items.title: Aggies Lose Close Contest at Oregon State 31-24
items.summary: CORVALLIS, Oregon – Utah State football battled to the end but ultimately dropped a close game on the road at Oregon State 31-24 on Saturday night at Reser Stadium.

items.title: Aggie Football Falls on the Road to San Diego State 30-13
items.summary: SAN DIEGO – Utah State football lost to San Diego State on the road 30-13 on Saturday night at Snapdragon Stadium.

items.title: Aggie Football Staves Off Fresno State for 17-10 Victory
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Another Utah State football game, another stellar showing from the Aggie defense.

items.title: Utah State’s Carson Tujague Named a Burlsworth Trophy Nominee
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State football sophomore Carson Tujague has been named a nominee for the 2026 Burlsworth Trophy. Tujague is one of 65 players in the nation nominated for the award.

items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State (3-5, 2-2 Pac-12) remains at Maverik Stadium for its lone back-to-back homestand of the 2026 season to host Fresno State (5-3, 2-2 Pac-12) on Saturday, Nov. 7, at 7:30 p.m. (MT). items.title: McCae Hillstead Named America First Credit Union Utah State Student-Athlete of the Week
items.summary: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State football junior quarterback McCae Hillstead has been named the America First Credit Union USU Student-Athlete of the Week for the period ending on Sunday, Nov. 1. The award is voted on by a state-wide media panel.
